title: Autonomous local BiBr4 geometry and Raman validation
difficulty_reasons: The object is fixed, while the Agent must independently select a computational model and validate a minimum and six low-frequency mode assignments.
Explicit pairing and aggregate geometry/frequency metrics are required.

paper.title: A new multifunctional one-dimensional bromo-bismuthate(iii): synthesis, structural features, characterization, and optical properties of (C10H13N4)[BiBr4]·2H2O

data.description: One explicit 5-atom BiBr4 fragment XYZ; atom 1 Bi, atoms 2-5 Br, charge -1 and singlet state.

required_deliverables.description: JSON report of provenance, optimized geometry, six frequencies, validation and comparison metrics.
